Who We Are

The Catalyst Story

Catalyst A/C & Heat was founded in ____ by Jerry Smith, who spent ____ years in HVAC before starting the company. Today Catalyst serves homeowners, property managers and businesses across Greater Houston from its shop in Southeast Houston, with residential repair, replacement and maintenance alongside multi-family, commercial and industrial work, including apartment and senior living communities. The goal is simple: tell customers what is actually wrong, give them clear options, and do the work right the first time.

What to Expect

What to Expect When You Contact Catalyst

  1. Diagnose

    A technician tests the system and finds the actual cause before recommending anything.

  2. Explain

    You see what was found, with photos when useful, and your options in plain language.

  3. Authorize

    You get the price before work begins. Nothing is done without your OK.

  4. Complete

    The work is done and the work area is cleaned up.

  5. Verify

    The technician confirms the system is running correctly before leaving.

  6. Follow Up

    Catalyst checks back after replacements and keeps your service history on file.

About Catalyst A/C & Heat

Is Catalyst A/C & Heat licensed in Texas?
Yes. Catalyst holds Texas air-conditioning and refrigeration contractor license # ____, issued by TDLR. You can verify it with the TDLR license lookup.
Is Catalyst insured?
Yes. Catalyst carries commercial general liability insurance, and a certificate is available on request.
Where is Catalyst A/C & Heat located?
Catalyst's executive office is in downtown Houston, and its shop and trucks are based in Southeast Houston off Easthaven Blvd. Service covers Greater Houston; see the Service Areas page for coverage.
Who owns Catalyst A/C & Heat?
Catalyst A/C & Heat is owned and led by Jerry Smith.
Does Catalyst work on homes and larger properties?
Yes. Catalyst provides residential heating and cooling service across Greater Houston, along with multi-family, commercial and industrial HVAC. That work includes service, planned maintenance, replacement and project coordination for apartment and senior living communities, commercial buildings and industrial facilities. See the Residential HVAC, Multi-Family HVAC, Commercial HVAC and Industrial HVAC pages for details.
What areas does Catalyst serve?
Catalyst serves all of Greater Houston. See the Service Areas page for current coverage.
Is Catalyst hiring?
See the Careers page for open positions and to submit a resume.
What HVAC brands does Catalyst service?
Catalyst services most major residential brands, including Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and American Standard, and installs Daikin equipment as a Daikin Pro.
